imageCacheSize.title: Symbol images in the cache
imageCacheSize.description: How many symbol images the render cache keeps (least recently used are dropped first).

x-emc2.hint: How many symbol images to keep; the least recently used go first

graphicTimeoutSeconds.title: Tactical graphic timeout
graphicTimeoutSeconds.description: How long a tactical graphic may take to draw, in seconds; a slower one is not drawn ("timeout").

x-emc2.hint: A tactical graphic that takes longer is not drawn

sensorReportShape.title: Sensor report shape
sensorReportShape.description: The shape every sensor report (e.g. a GMTI detection) is drawn as on the map: dot, cross, ring, diamond or square.

x-emc2.hint: Every sensor report, e.g. a GMTI detection, is drawn as this shape

sensorReportColor.title: Sensor report colour
sensorReportColor.description: The colour of the sensor report symbol; it has a black outline (white for black).

x-emc2.hint: The symbol's colour; its outline is black, white for a black symbol

sensorReportSize.title: Sensor report size
sensorReportSize.description: The size of the sensor report symbol, in pixels.

groups.label: Sensor reports
groups.description: How sensor reports, such as GMTI detections, are drawn on the map.

groups.label: Advanced
groups.description: Limits of the symbol renderer: its image cache and how long a tactical graphic may take.
